steps.name: An Evening at Ash Tree
steps.objective: Find [Embla] in 「Nidaros」 and watch the story, then press the [Complete Quest] button to finish the quest.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Can't drink another drop... Mmm... I'll burst if I keep this up.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Why does he drink so much when he can't handle it...?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Hey, go home. Please, just go. Business is bad enough already... Go on. Or do I have to throw you out?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Mr. Stellan... Mmm... I did what you said... Mmm... Nidaros and Embla will be all right now...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Don't worry so much... Mmm...

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Askren, you think I don't know, don't you?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I'll wait. Tell me properly when you're ready...

steps.name: The Cousins' Evening
steps.objective: Find [Carmen] in 「Nidaros」 and watch the story, then press the [Complete Quest] button to finish the quest.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: One, two, three, glissade, assemblé...

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Hey, you're off the beat! All you have to do is count in time. How are you getting that wrong?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Isn't this right?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: No. Try again.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: One, two, three, glissade, assemblé...

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: You're still off the beat. Has my little brother always had no sense of rhythm?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Uh, I think it's right...

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Oh, come on, Carmen. Why make me do this? I don't even dance.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Didn't you say you were sorry? And that you'd do as I asked?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Fine. I'll try something else, then. Ready? I'm doing a different one.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Is this how it goes?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: One, two, three, tombé, pas de bourrée.
(Carmen practices her steps diligently to Lars' count.)

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: One, two, three, glissade, assemblé... Pause, then one, two, three, tombé, pas de bourrée...

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: You're good, Carmen. Better than before.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: What was that?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: If you didn't hear me, forget it.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Oh, I heard you perfectly! You said, 'Carmen, you're so good! You've improved so much, you're amazing!'

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I didn't say all that! I didn't!

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Hehe, you're a sweet kid. You know what? When I pass the Plata Dance Company's audition and perform as their lead dancer, I'll get you a good seat.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Huh? Were you planning not to invite your family until now?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Lars! I'm touched. You just assumed your big sister would pass!

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Oh, enough. Get on with it.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: One, two, three, glissade, assemblé... One, two, three, tombé, pas de bourrée.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: What's next? Hurry up and tell me. If you don't, I'm going home!
